name: devbox
postCreateCommand: bash -c 'if [ -n "${GIT_USER_NAME:-}" ]; then git config --global user.name "$GIT_USER_NAME"; git config --global user.email "${GIT_USER_EMAIL:-}"; fi'
postStartCommand: bash -c 'sudo chown -R dev:dev /home/dev/.claude /home/dev/.claude.json /home/dev/.codex 2>/dev/null || true; sudo service ssh start || true; if [ -f /home/dev/.ssh-host/authorized_keys ] && [ ! -f /home/dev/.ssh/authorized_keys ]; then cp /home/dev/.ssh-host/authorized_keys /home/dev/.ssh/authorized_keys && chmod 600 /home/dev/.ssh/authorized_keys; fi; [ -f /workspaces/project/.devcontainer/local-poststart.sh ] && bash /workspaces/project/.devcontainer/local-poststart.sh || true'
